title: Meta video · denser motion · 3 fps (up to 40 s)
disclosure: Experimental denser source sampling: up to 3 fps for a 40-second original recording, at most 120 frames and 768 pixels on the longest side (even dimensions; a 9:16 portrait becomes 432×768). Sends sampled frames to Meta for Muse Spark reasoning and one SAM 3.1 video request using unchanged model-proposed box seeds. The API derivative encodes ONE sampled frame per encoded second, so its playback duration is not the source duration. Each submitted frame remains explicitly bound to its original source PTS; encoded seconds never replace source timestamps. Missing/withheld masks stay absent. TripoSR (non-Meta) reconstruction and CoTracker3 motion remain local. The shared $100 estimated-cost guard applies; denser counts do not prove physical accuracy or identity. This is not an account credit balance or a verified physical twin.
